data.name: Trupti
data.gender_notes: Trupti is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root tṛp, 'to be satisfied' — tṛpti, 'satisfaction'. Its root is Sanskrit tṛp (तृप्). A classical Sanskrit term for contentment. Trupti is a Sanskrit name meaning “Satisfaction; contentment”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Trupti expresses “Satisfaction; contentment”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root tṛp, 'to be satisfied' — tṛpti, 'satisfaction'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Trupti total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
